items.title: ❗️Polish Foreign Minister Radosław Sikorski, who previously clashed with Elon Musk over Starlink (particularly after threats to cut off communications for Ukraine), ironically addressed the American businessman on X regarding the new restrictions on Ukrainian terminals. Poland funds a significant share of Ukrainian Starlinks — over 29,000 terminals and about $50 million per year. At the same time, Ukraine’s Ministry of Defense and advisors confirmed that SpaceX introduced speed limits on Starlink/StarShield terminals without prior notice (connectivity drops during movement above ~160 km/h), which disrupted a number of military missions, and are investigating the causes of these restrictions.

Anything flying faster than 100 miles per hour will lose signal. The Ukrainian side wasn't informed about this limitation and in the process lost several missions. It has to be paraphrased that Starlink only operates in Ukraine and cannot be used on Russian territory. The measure is therefore not aimed in stopping Ukraine in striking legitimate targets - including refineries - in Russia, but to deprive it from defending itself against an aggressive invader which never stops committing the most heinous atrocities. Ukraine was also for a second time not informed about the impending missile attack which suggest that intelligence sharing has been suspended or the very least decreased. Therefore, it is certain to assume that this is an organized effort with the current US administration in the White House at helm.

items.title: RT by @front_ukrainian: ❗️I want to express my deepest gratitude to the Australian people for their unwavering support of Ukraine. From the very first days of Russia’s full-scale invasion, Australia has stood firmly with us — providing substantial military assistance, including Bushmaster armoured vehicles, M113 armoured personnel carriers, M777 howitzers, air defence systems and radars, munitions, drones (including innovative Australian cardboard drones), rigid-hulled boats, and 49 M1A1 Abrams tanks. Australian instructors have also trained thousands of Ukrainian soldiers under Operation Kudu as part of the multinational training effort, helping build critical skills in leadership, trench and urban warfare, and battlefield readiness. Beyond the battlefield, Australia has committed nearly AUD 1.9 billion in total support, including financial, humanitarian, and reconstruction aid, as well as significant contributions to Ukraine’s Energy Support Fund to help keep lights on, homes heated, and essential services running amid relentless attacks on infrastructure. It has prioritised visa applications and opened its doors to thousands of Ukrainians seeking safety, while imposing extensive sanctions on Russia and its enablers. In September 2026, Australia further strengthened its commitment by signing a Bilateral Security Agreement with Ukraine. Thank you, beautiful Australia and your wonderful people, for standing with us not just with words, but with real, consistent action. Your solidarity means more than we can say. 🇺🇦❤️🇦🇺

items.title: R to @NOELreports: Update on the Velyka Novosilka axis
items.summary:
Update on the Velyka Novosilka axis
NOELREPORTS 🇪🇺 🇺🇦 (@NOELreports)
A little extra on the Velyka Novosilka direction. We have corrected our map with changes that happened over the last few months and weeks, as the situation in this particular area has shifted considerably. Activity has increased again in recent weeks, with Ukrainian forces making several confirmed gains, improving their positions and gradually pushing back Russian forward elements across a wider part of this axis.
Over the last period, Ukraine has largely shut down Russian infiltration attempts into Novopavlivka, while also improving the situation further south. These actions came alongside a pushback of Russian forward groups present in the forest areas between Filiia and Yalta. Ukraine now holds firm positions there, while remaining Russian elements in and around the forest belts are being pushed into an increasingly narrow area towards Dachne.
The situation there was needed to allow Ukrainian units located further south to advance from Yalta and Zirka towards Zaporizhzhia, which has been liberated in recent days. Ukrainian forces have also expanded their positions east of the settlement. Pressure towards Dachne is now being applied from multiple directions, including along both sides of the Vovcha River, with the broader operational direction becoming increasingly clear: continuing the push towards Bahatyr.
Meanwhile, like we reported a few days ago, the forward operations which Ukraine calls "active defense" are still ongoing towards Fedorivka and Komar. Ukrainian units have improved their positions around Perebudova and in the western part of Komar, while pressure continues along the surrounding tree lines and approaches. These actions are possibly setting the stage for another wider push once the area northeast of Komar is more firmly secured and Russian positions there are further weakened.
— http://shitter.thepixora.com/NOELreports/status/2109960682284175758#m

items.title: President Zelenskyy has given his first interview after Trump‘s most recent attacks. „We are open for an energy ceasefire. We are open for this. (Just) don’t attack us, don’t kill our children. And we will stop attacking your diesel.“ „President Trump said that Ukraine needs a new president. First of all with all respect to President Trump, it is up to our society, up to our people to chose one or another leader. Yes, we are at war and elections are really difficult and against our constitution. The main issue, (however), is to have a safe environment for this happen, so that people can vote. It is up to the Ukrainian people who to elect. I know that Putin wanted to exchange the Ukrainian president. I understand that. If President Trump wants elections I told his team to tell Putin to give us two months, 60 days total ceasefire and we will organize elections. Of course we will be ready of the choice of our people.“ The pressure President Zelenskyy is experiencing is otherworldly, and of top of that he has to endure Trump‘s regular attacks. Yet, he keeps cool. He knows that too much is at stake, than to give in to emotions. Stunning.

items.title: RT by @COUPSURE: Today, Russia expressed its thanks for the lifting of sanctions on diesel exports by dropping five glide bombs on residential buildings in Zaporizhzhia. As of now, sadly, twelve people have been confirmed killed, including three children. My condolences to all their families and loved ones. Another fourteen people have been injured, and two of them are in critical condition – the doctors are fighting to save their lives. The status of twelve more people who may have been there is still being verified. All emergency services are at the scene, and search-and-rescue operations are underway. Overnight, thirteen of our regions came under attack. Residential buildings, infrastructure, and railway facilities have been damaged. Last night confirmed once again that in Russia, they take any easing of pressure to mean they can keep fighting, to mean they can keep dropping bombs on cities. Different signals are needed. Russia must understand that it needs to stop the war, and for that to happen, Russia must feel its losses. Right now, it is our long-range capabilities that are ensuring this. And we will respond to Russian strikes. I thank everyone who is helping.
